resources.string: Lets band gestures swipe and tap the screen, press Back, Home or Recent apps, and open apps or the voice assistant. For per-app profiles it notices which app is open. Air Gestures reads nothing on screen.

Types what you write with the band into the text field you\'re in. It notices which field has the focus, and reads and changes only that field\'s text; password fields are left alone. Nothing is kept or leaves the phone.
Lets band gestures move a focus outline between the buttons, links and fields on screen, press them and scroll. To find them it reads the screen\'s layout; nothing is kept or leaves the phone.
The band\'s connection, battery and profile, with power and controls buttons.
